entries.subtitle: 5 models · 85 pts · Battleline

blocks.v: 1 Intercessor Sergeant · 4 Intercessors
Bolt rifles, bolt pistols, close combat weapons. The Sergeant may take a power fist or power weapon instead of a bolt rifle.
**Squads Endurance** — while this unit contains its full starting number of models, it has the Objective Secured ability (controls objectives as if it had double its OC).

entries.name: Terminator Squad
entries.subtitle: 5 models · 170 pts

blocks.v: 1 Terminator Sergeant · 4 Terminators
Storm bolters and power fists. One model may take an assault cannon; the Sergeant may take a power sword or thunder hammer.

**Teleport Strike** — during the Declare Battle Formations step, this unit can be set up in reserves instead of on the battlefield; it can be placed more than 9" from enemy models using its Deep Strike ability.
Infantry, Terminator, Terminator Squad, Imperium, Adeptus Astartes

Infantry, Character, Tacticus, Captain, Imperium, Adeptus Astartes

entries.name: Redemptor Dreadnought
entries.subtitle: 1 model · 210 pts · Vehicle

blocks.v: Macro plasma incinerator, Icarus rocket pod, Redemptor fist. May take a heavy onslaught gatling cannon and twin fragstorm grenade launchers.

**Emergency Plasma Vent** — if this model is destroyed by a melee attack, roll one d6 for each model in that attacking unit; on a 5+ it suffers 3 mortal wounds. **Redemptor** — this model can move through enemy models but must end outside Engagement Range.

entries.name: Armour of Contempt
entries.subtitle: 2 CP · Space Marines · Battle Tactic

blocks.v: Opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of those attacks.

blocks.t: Until the end of the phase, worsen the **Armour Penetration** of attacks made against that unit by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

entries.text: armour of contempt 2 cp space marines battle tactic worsen armour penetration

entries.name: Command Re-roll
entries.subtitle: 1 CP · Core Rules · Strategic Ploy

blocks.v: After you make a hit roll, a wound roll, a damage roll, or a saving throw for an attack made by or against a unit from your army.
That unit.

blocks.t: You can re-roll that roll. A unit can only benefit from this Stratagem once per phase.

entries.text: command re-roll 1 cp core rules strategic ploy re-roll that roll

entries.name: Counter-offensive
entries.subtitle: 2 CP · Core Rules · Strategic Ploy

blocks.v: During the Fight phase, after an enemy unit has fought.
One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of an enemy unit.

blocks.t: Your unit fights next, before any other eligible units.

entries.text: counter offensive 2 cp core rules strategic ploy fight next

entries.name: Insane Bravery
entries.subtitle: 1 CP · Core Rules · Epic Deed

blocks.v: The start of the Command phase, when a unit from your army takes a Battle-shock test.
That unit.

blocks.t: Your unit automatically **passes** that Battle-shock test.
